calculation.description: Contrarian three-session return, scaled by trailing 20-session realized volatility; computed using completed bars and aligned to next-session return. Higher values indicate stronger recent losses after volatility adjustment.

validation.regime_notes: Positive mean IC in 2020-2022 (0.04495), 2022-2024 (0.02321), and 2024-2026 (0.04752); uncertainty is material because the cross-section has 15 instruments.

decay.note: Only same-horizon daily IC used for admission.
